waybackify site [flags] [command]

Whole-site source: enumerate · export

The whole-site source — mirror every archived version of every URL
under a host, domain, or prefix:

  enumerate CDX index → one capture list per site (a ledger)
  export    a filled cache root → <host>/<timestamp>/<path> files

Between the two, the ledger is filled like any other: `cache fill
--converge`, `cache remediate`, `cache verify`, `cache status`.

Run `waybackify site <verb> --help` for a verb's full surface.

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  enumerate   Enumerate every archived version of whole sites into a ledger
  export      Export a cache root as a browsable path tree

part of the wayback mirror tooling
